item.title: Version 1.4.1
item.description:
What's new in 1.4.1

  • Fix: quitting now turns the system proxy back off. Closing or quitting Moni Proxy used to leave the macOS proxy pointing at a port that was no longer listening, which broke internet access for every app until you reset it by hand. Every exit route now cleans up, and if a previous run was force-quit or crashed, the next launch undoes it for you.
  • Environment variables — define a value once and reuse it as {{name}} across mocks, rewrite rules and scripts; switch Dev / Staging / Prod in one tap.
  • Weak network simulation — latency, bandwidth limits, packet loss or full offline, applied only to the URLs you choose. Presets for GPRS, 2G, 3G, 4G and Weak Wi-Fi. Off by default.
  • GraphQL — the request list now shows each call's operation name instead of a column of identical /graphql rows.
  • Text Diff — compare two payloads line by line with the changed characters highlighted (Tools → Text Diff).
